cases.title: Incumbent FM renewal — market alternatives confirmed, walk-away approved by CFO

inputs.negotiation_objective: Reduce total contract value by 12% vs. current spend; improve SLA response times

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
negotiation plan includes: opening position, walk-away point, at least 2 concession options
leverage assessment references market alternatives as real, not theoretical
walk-away positions flagged as confidential — must not be shared externally
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
assumptions notes that incumbent's actual cost structure is inferred, not confirmed

cases.title: Supplier name and category only — no market data, no baseline, no objectives
pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: negotiation objective not defined, market alternatives not identified, baseline spend not provided
skill does not generate a negotiation plan without minimum inputs
open_questions contains at least: negotiation objective, walk-away position, available market alternatives

cases.title: 15% cost reduction target but market scan shows supplier has pricing power

inputs.market_scan_finding: GasSupplierCo is one of only two certified suppliers for this gas type in the region; switching would require 6-month recertification

pass_signals: conflict between 15% reduction target and supplier pricing power is explicitly surfaced
skill does not present a 15% reduction as achievable without caveating market reality
risk_flags contains: limited market alternatives reduce realistic leverage
open_questions contains: is the 15% target realistic given market position? Should walk-away be confirmed before negotiation?
confidence_level is MEDIUM — plan is conditional on leverage assumptions being validated
assumptions contains: supplier pricing power based on market scan — must be confirmed with stakeholders

cases.title: Negotiation already in progress with active supplier offers — fresh plan requested

inputs.negotiation_stage: active — supplier has submitted two commercial offers
inputs.instruction: Generate a fresh negotiation plan with new targets and positions.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: negotiation already in progress — generating fresh baseline positions risks contradicting communicated stance
escalation_required is true
skill does not generate new baseline targets without flagging the in-flight conflict
open_questions contains: confirm what positions have been communicated before updating the plan
skill recommends updating existing plan rather than regenerating from scratch
confidence_level is LOW — new positions cannot be validated against what has already been communicated
